title: Nutty, Crispy, Light Moroccan Beef Tagine
description: A low-glycemic-friendly, nutty, crispy, and light Moroccan dish featuring corned beef and long-fermentation-dough.
instructions: Roll out the Long Fermentation Dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch (6 mm).
Cut the dough into 4-6 pieces, depending on desired crust size.
Place the dough pieces on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Dust the dough with Caraway Seeds and Cumin Seeds.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of Olive Oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped Onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced Garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the Corned Beef to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Transfer the Corned Beef mixture to the dough pieces and top with Garam Masala and Paprika.
Brush the edges of the dough with the remaining 1 tablespoon of Olive Oil and fold the dough over the filling to form a seal.
Bake the Tagine in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and crispy.
